scope: One native Windows default-feature unit-test invocation, two isolated local-workspace contexts. No complete CLI jobs or performance samples.

parameters.key_membership: preassigned id % 2; monotonic original ordinals, no RNG membership test

observations.error: concurrent algorithm workspaces exceed memory budget; increase memory_mb

cleanup: Both contexts asserted temporary bytes zero and final workspace equal held other+directory grants; dropping other returns directory baseline. Failure raw rows=0 is a missing-result placeholder, not number of input rows visited.
limits: Test-only context overrides are not supported CLI memory settings. This probes the sorter physical path, not full-job publication, probabilistic membership, RSS, physical I/O, real concurrent Jobs or browser behavior. It establishes a retained-versus-immediate admission difference in this controlled state, not prevalence in production. Exact denied allocation is not instrumented; the source overlap explanation is an inference, while the observed success-domain difference is direct.
